title: CHAPTER 11: RAJBHASHA IN REGIONAL RURAL BANKS (RRBs)

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Focuses on the framework for Hindi implementation across Regional Rural Banks (RRBs).
Details the official duties and administrative responsibilities assigned to the Rajbhasha Adhikari.

blocks.content: Duties and Responsibilities of Rajbhasha Adhikari

cells: RRBs are required to implement Official Language Policy under the Official Languages Act 1963 and Rules 1976; they are Central Government offices for the purposes of OL policy
RBI issues guidelines to RRBs on Hindi implementation similar to those for all scheduled banks; RBI's Annual Programme covers RRBs; Rajbhasha cells to be set up at all RRBs
NABARD supervises RRBs; also ensures that RRBs comply with OL policy guidelines; NABARD's own Rajbhasha Vibhag coordinates
Most RRBs in North India (UP, Bihar, Rajasthan, MP, Haryana, Uttarakhand) fall in Region A :highest Hindi targets; South India RRBs in Region C :English correspondence predominant
All RRB forms for opening accounts, KCC, loans, nomination :must be in bilingual format; passbooks and FD receipts must have Hindi
In addition to Hindi, RRBs in non-Hindi areas may also use the state official language; schedule VIII language of the state where RRB operates
Rajbhasha Adhikari heads the Hindi cell; reports to CMD or ED; responsible for training, inspection, QPR preparation, TOLIC participation, Hindi competitions

blocks.content: 11.2 Duties and Responsibilities of Rajbhasha Adhikari

cells: Ensure bank's compliance with OL Act 1963, Rules 1976, and RBI's annual programme directives
Arrange and coordinate Hindi training (Prabodh/Praveen/Pragya) for all staff; maintain training records; send staff to CHTI
Translate documents, circulars, notices from English to Hindi; ensure quality of translations; review translated material
Inspect branches and offices for Hindi compliance; check bilingual displays, correspondence, forms; prepare inspection reports; submit to Head Office and TOLIC
Prepare and submit QPR to DoOL and RBI on quarterly basis; collect data from all offices; analyse and report on targets vs actuals
Organise essay writing, dictation, translation, noting-drafting competitions during Hindi Month; announce results; recommend prizes
Ensure CBS, ATMs, mobile banking are available in Hindi; coordinate with IT department for Unicode Hindi enablement; ensure digital forms are bilingual
Implement incentive scheme for Hindi work; process applications for incentive payments; verify original Hindi noting/drafting
Represent bank in TOLIC meetings; coordinate with sponsor bank on Hindi activities; liaise with DoOL Regional Offices; participate in inter-TOLIC activities
Prepare Hindi chapter for bank's Annual Report; include progress, awards, competitions, training data; submit for Board review
